updates.content:
Title: Users may be unable to perform migrations

User impact: Users may be unable to perform migrations

More info: Migrations that use Migration Manager Platform (MMP) API will be impacted. These include migrations initiated from Microsoft 365 Admin Center and third-party migrations. Migrations using SPMT (Sharepoint Migration Tool) will not be impacted. 

Current status: After reviewing telemetry data, we’ve identified the source of the issue and have narrowed our investigation to the specific conditions contributing to the impact. We’re now assessing the most effective mitigation options and determining the actions required to restore normal service as quickly and safely as possible.

Next update: Wednesday, October 21, 2026 at 1:00 PM UTC

Current status: We’ve identified a fix to address the underlying issue and are completing validation cycles to confirm that it resolves the impact without introducing additional risk. Once these checks are complete, we’ll begin deploying the fix to the affected environment. We’ll closely monitor service telemetry throughout the deployment to verify recovery and confirm that the fix is having the intended effect. We’ll provide a further update as deployment progresses.

Scope of impact: Admins attempting to migrate using Migration Manager Platform (MMP) API will be impacted.
